narr: Runoff from heavy rain caused flash flooding north and west of Faith. Runoff flooded a few roads and accumulated in several fields and ditches.
ev: Runoff from heavy rain caused Arrowhead Road north of Faith to flood. Water also ponded in fields and ditches. Over three inches of rain fell in about two hours.
Runoff from heavy rain caused 196th Place west-southwest of Faith to flood. Water also ponded in fields and ditches. Over three inches of rain fell in about two hours.
lsr: Water over Arrowhead Road about 2 miles north of Faith.
Water over 194th Place in a few locations.
